ws_outreach_policy.title: Outreach Policy
values: Never send outreach to contacts whose notes mention 'opted out' of marketing emails. This is a legal compliance requirement.
Do not send cold outreach to contacts in the Government industry. These require a formal RFP process and unsolicited emails may violate procurement rules.
Only contact leads with lifecycle_stage='Lead'. Do not re-engage existing Customers through this cold outreach workflow.

ws_engagement_logging.title: Engagement Logging
values: All engagement log entries must include the contact's industry in the body text for analytics tracking.
